en: Whew, I'm a bit worn out.
Why not, this looks like a decent enough spot for a break.
Kyahaha (laughs)
?! Who's there?
Eeek!
Ah, there you are, you monster!
*sniffle* That's mean.  Calling me, adorable little me, a monster, of all things.
Eh?  Eh?  Eh?
*sniffle* Even though I just wanted to talk to you.
Oh I'm so sorry.
Okay, I'll forgive you!
(somehow, she seems awfully full of herself...)
What's the matter?
Oh, nothing's wrong.
Say, can I ask you something?
What is it?
Why did the monsters abduct my father?
I've been wondering about it this whole time and I haven't come up with any reason why they'd want to.
The mister's research was a huge inconvenience to some bad guys.  They grabbed him so that he couldn't do it any more.
Do you know where Father is being kept?
I don't know.
Ah.
Well how about Father's research topic, then?
Was it really something bad enough to be kidnapped over?
I'd like you to find that out on your own.
You rely on others a bit too much, sister.
(I've just been rebuked by a half-pint.)
Well then, I'll be on my way now.  That's bye-bye to you!
Ah, hey, wait up!
Awww, she left.
So it was Father's research, huh.
Racking my brain doesn't help; that just makes it clear how little I really know about him and his work.
Guess I should try to do some investigating.
Let's see...  There might be something about this in our study.  Let's head back to the manor.
